The above appeal is filed challenging the judgment and award dated 15.05.2015 in MVC.No.1083/2012 passed by the VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge at Tumkur, dismissing the claim petition.

sentences.text:
2. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
3.

Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant submitted that just because there is one day delay in lodging the complaint and minor discrepancy in mentioning the date of the accident, the Tribunal rejecting the claim petition is illegal and erroneous.

It is further submitted that the appellant-claimant was working as a Collection Manager at Vishwa Vijetha Chita Private Limited,
Tumakuru, earning Rs.10,000/- p.m., and he is the sole NC: 2023:KHC:21207 bread-winner in the family.
It is contended that even today, he is unable to do any work and taking treatment and he is crippled with no avocation to lead life.
Therefore, prays to set aside the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal and to allow the appeal filed by the claimant and grant compensation.
4. Learned counsel for the Respondent No.2.- Insurance Company submitted that there are major contradictions in the evidence of PW.2 and the date of the accident is also in dispute.

Hence, the Insurance Company is not liable to pay the compensation and the appeal may be dismissed.
5. The facts of the case are as under:
On 13.08.2012, the petitioner in MVC No.1083/2012 was going as a pillion rider in Bajaj CT-100 bearing No. KA-06-V-6492 ridden by the petitioner in MVC No.1084/2012 and when they came near Bandihalli Gate, NH-206 road, Nittur Hobli,
Gubbi Taluk, at about NC: 2023:KHC:21207 3.00 p.m., and crossing the road, a Tata Indica Car bearing No.KA-05-C-7099 driven in a rash and negligent manner at high M R Gangaraju vs Muniyamma on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193271726/
2 speed, came from Tumakuru side and dashed against their motor-cycle, due to which,
the appellant-petitioner in MVC No.1083/2012 fell down and sustained multiple injuries.
He was shifted to Adithya Hospital, Tumakuru and took treatment as in-patient for one month and spent Rs.1,00,000/- towards treatment and other charges.
The offending vehicle, i.e., the car bearing No.KA-05-C-7099 was belonging to Respondent No.1-Muniyamma and insured with Respondent No.2- insurance Company.
Hence, both are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.
Respondent No.1 was placed exparte before the Tribunal.

Respondent No.2-Insurance Company denied the petition averments and contended that the rider of the bike bearing No.KA-06-V-6492 was driving the bike in a rash and negligent manner and was not having a valid driving licence.
It is further averred that the petition is NC: 2023:KHC:21207 bad for non-joinder of necessary parties and there is one day delay in lodging the complaint.

6. The claim petition filed by the claimant is dismissed by the Tribunal on the ground that the injured was admitted to the hospital on 11.08.2012, but the date of accident is mentioned as 13.08.2012.
On this ground, the Tribunal has dismissed the claim petition.
7. Now, in the appeal, the claimant has filed application for amendment praying to make amendment to the claim petition regarding date of the accident.
When this being the disputed fact regarding the date of accident, for ascertaining the same, it can be tried before the Tribunal, but not in this appeal.
Therefore, the matter is required to be remanded to the Tribunal for fresh consideration for ascertaining the correct date of accident.

8. Therefore, I pass the following:
NC: 2023:KHC:21207 ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed and the Judgment and Award dated 15.05.2015 in MVC.No.1083/2012 passed by the VI Addl.
District and Sessions Judge at Tumkur, is set aside.
